description: Startup concurrency policy. Two parallel lanes: long-running services (detached, non-blocking) and incremental data refresh (locked, idempotent). Schema migrations and full rebuilds are explicitly NEVER auto-run.

serviceLane.label: Long-running AI services — spawned once, idempotent health-checks

dataLane.label: Incremental cache + ranking refresh — Redis-locked, git-diff scoped

manualOnly.label: Operator-triggered tasks — VS Code task palette only, never folderOpen
manualOnly.rationale: Schema changes, destructive rebuilds, force overrides, and full-corpus re-embedding must be deliberate operator decisions. Surfaced as VS Code tasks with reveal=always + focus=true so the operator sees the output.
